text.p: BLANTYRE, Jan 13 (Reuter) These are the leading stories in the Malawi press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Taiwanese Foreign Minister John Chang is expected to arrive in Malawi on Monday for a four-day visit and will meet President Bakili Muluzi on Wednesday, the Taiwanese embassy said.

- The Anglican Church says it will not officiate the controversial marriage of Deputy Health Minister Catherine Chipembere and Alford Marama until a row with her late husband's relations over the use of the family name is resolved.

- Home Affairs Ministry Under Secretary Jekete Masiona said on Sunday the government has switched to buying Landrovers in place of Indian made Tata vehicles -- a year after spending three million Malawi kwacha on the Tata vehicles which have proved unreliable.

- A Zambian citizen known as Chipofya said he was allegedly hired by a cabinet minister from the opposition Alliance for Democracy (AFORD), to assassinate AFORD president Chakufwa Chihna. The man, who has gone missing, did not disclose the minister's name.
